name: wip-kanban
description: A read-only Kanban of the project's open wip items, in a pane of Claude Code.

webUrl.title: Web URL
webUrl.description: Base URL only while no server of this project answers; a running server's LAN URL wins, then its Local URL. An invalid URL leaves the IDs as plain text.

colorScheme.title: Colour scheme
colorScheme.description: The theme the pane paints for: dark, the first-run default of Claude Code, or light.
